protocol_notes.compile_timeout: Attempts measured in v1 and v2 used the frozen standard 1200s. The v3 continuation used the frozen extended 3600s, after a single pandas build was measured at 1054s of 1200s. The limit bounds infrastructure failure only; a compile that succeeds is unaffected by which limit applied.
protocol_notes.abi_rebuild_amendment: Attempts for pandas IDs 37, 38, 41, 42, 43, 44, 45 were measured with the harness ABI rebuild enabled, under the written amendment AMENDMENT-20260921.md. The rebuild changes workspace preparation only; generation, candidate order and scoring are unchanged. ID 46 is not in the eligibility set and contributes no attempt.
protocol_notes.batching: Four-bug batching was withdrawn for pandas bugs because concurrent native builds exceeded the compile limit. pandas bugs are measured one per job.
